title: Crash when use `set_plugin_enabled("plugin_name", false)` to disable plugin in `_enter_tree`.
body:
### Tested versions Reproducible in 4.7, and also 4.2.2(which I just have) ### System information Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT i5-12400F ### Issue description Crash when use `get_editor_interface().set_plugin_enabled("same_folder", false)` to disable plugin ```gdscript @tool extends EditorPlugin func _enter_tree() -> void: get_editor_interface().set_plugin_enabled("same_folder", false) func _exit_tree() -> void: pass ```
